# Sample per-scene manual board ROI — REPLACE before calibrating real data.
#
# When this file sits next to a scene's cloud, fast_calib applies it
# automatically (and switches that scene to manual-ROI mode, overriding the
# config's use_auto_lidar_roi / x_min..z_max). It is normally generated by:
#
#   python3 scripts/pick_roi.py calib_data/<cam>/<scene>/cloud.pcd --yaml config/cameras/<cam>.yaml
#
# (shift-click >=4 points on the board, press Q; the picked box +-0.10 m
# padding is written here and into the config).
#
# Values below are a real example (AT128, board ~2.4 m in front): a tight box
# around the 1.4 x 1.0 m board face in the LiDAR frame [meters]. If your board
# is elsewhere, these bounds will crop it out — delete this file to use the
# config's ROI, or re-pick.
  x_min: 1.94
  x_max: 2.86
  y_min: -0.30
  y_max: 1.25
  z_min: -0.61
  z_max: 0.48
